name: Sheba
bio: Sheba son of Bichri was a Benjamite troublemaker who, amid the bitter rivalry between Israel and Judah over David's return, blew a trumpet and cried, "We have no share in David, no part in Jesse's son! Every man to his tent, Israel!" Every man of Israel abandoned David to follow Sheba, while only Judah stayed loyal to their king (2 Samuel 20:1-2). David sent Amasa to muster Judah's forces against him, and when Amasa delayed, sent Joab and Abishai in pursuit instead; Sheba's revolt and its violent end, including Joab's murder of Amasa along the way, are told in detail in the chapters ahead.
